bullets: Developed and maintained 4+ Spring Boot microservices supporting enterprise finance workflows.
Built and maintained 20+ REST APIs using Java, Spring Boot, Spring Data JPA, and SQL Server.
Implemented JWT authentication and role-based access control (RBAC) to secure APIs and finance operations.
Improved service resilience using Redis caching and Resilience4j Circuit Breaker and Retry patterns.
Integrated RabbitMQ for asynchronous service communication and Kafka for event-driven email workflows.
Developed and maintained Angular modules for finance workflows, validation, and journal generation.
Optimized SQL workflows, reducing manual effort by approximately 50% and saving 15+ hours per month-end cycle.
Performed root-cause analysis for 40+ production incidents and contributed to reliability improvements.
Wrote unit tests using JUnit and Mockito and supported application releases and production enhancements.
